title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into the ruins entrance, a familiar figure slowly emerged from the darkness—it was his sister Chen Nian, whom he had been searching for years. At this moment, she gazed at him with an unfamiliar yet complicated expression.

text.content: Late autumn twilight spread across the sky like ink. In a hidden cave at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a crude stone bed, the spiritual light around him dim as a flickering candle in the wind. Three years had passed. Ever since the seventh volume of the Tianji Record was unsealed, he had faked death due to "incurable severe injuries" to escape, hiding here to cultivate. Unless absolutely necessary, he never left the cave. The outside world believed thattrash杂役弟子 had turned to dust, yet the occasional message talisman reminded him—the chess game continued, and he was the only one who knew the entire playbook.

However, tonight was different. Just after midnight, the Tianji Record mark at Chen Ji's brow center suddenly pulsed violently. Then, an unfamiliar yet familiar blood pulse burst forth from his chest, like a fierce beast that had slept for millennia suddenly opening its eyes. The sensation was as if countless threads descended from the void, their ends connected to an existence that haunted his soul—the call of bloodline, the bond of flesh and blood. "This is..." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his pupils contracting sharply. He clearly sensed that the direction of that blood resonance was precisely where his father had mentioned—the depths of the Tianji Pavilion ruins.

dialogue.content: Father, what exactly did you leave in that jade slip?

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record fragments whirled through his Mental Sea, countless runes scattering like fireflies. He saw it—three ancient jade slips悬浮于时空裂隙之前, their surfaces carved with the unique bloodline marks of the Chen family. And at the core of that temporal-spatial rift, a slender feminine silhouette vaguely emerged. The figure was too blurry to discern features, yet that bone-deep familiarity made Chen Ji feel as if he had fallen into an icy abyss while being struck by lightning simultaneously. "Spirit... spiritual consciousness?" His voice was hoarse and barely recognizable, his hands trembling slightly. Five years. His sister, whom he had苦苦寻觅了五年, the Chen bloodline abducted by the Holy Sect, had appeared in his foresight in this manner.

choice.prompt: The bloodline's call was so intense, but every use of the Tianji Record consumed 5 Heavenly Fate points, and the foresight images of Chen Nian's location were so blurry... Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.text: Immediately use the Tianji Record to peer
choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to forcefully peer into more details about the temporal-spatial rift and Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, learn the exact location of the ruins entrance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may affect future foresight abilities

text.content: The Tianji Record fragments shook violently, 5 Heavenly Fate points flowing away like water. Chen Ji's vision suddenly darkened, and when he "saw" again, the image had become much clearer—the temporal-spatial rift was located at the deepest part of the Tianji Pavilion ruins, requiring passage through triple layers of forbidden formations. And that blurry feminine silhouette... was indeed Chen Nian beyond doubt. She seemed trapped within some kind of barrier, desperately shouting something outward, yet no sound could be heard.

choices.text: Rely on memory to search for clues
choices.description: Don't consume Heavenly Fate points, recall whether father left any clues about the Tianji Pavilion before his death
choices.visible_reward: May discover hidden jade slip left by father
choices.risk_hint: The recollection may be incomplete, time-consuming

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the焦灼 in his heart. He closed his eyes, his father's生前点滴 flickering through his mind like a carousel. Suddenly, his eyes snapped open, his gaze falling on the unremarkable blue stone beneath the stone bed—the stone's patterns were unmistakably a map of the Tianji Pavilion ruins!

choices.text: First contact Mo Xiansheng to inquire
choices.description: Activate the first page of the Tianji Record, seek advice from the remnant soul guardian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information and unlock new knowledge
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may only reveal part of the truth

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip gently touched his brow center, and the first page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out from the yellowed page, his translucent figure carrying the vicissitudes of accumulated years. "You finally sensed it." Mo Xiansheng sighed, "That is a bloodline mark Chen Tianming set before his death, only activating at specific moments—his son, you should go there."

Since his resolve was set, Chen Ji hesitated no more. He rose and walked toward the blue stone slab deep within the cave, the one carved with map patterns. Following the positions from memory, he gently pressed down. As Spiritual Energy was injected, the stone slab slowly slid aside, revealing a narrow Hidden Compartment. Within it, three jade slips lay still, warm and lustrous as goat's fat, their surfaces faintly glimmering with pale golden light. Chen Ji carefully lifted them out, and the moment his fingertips touched the slips, a warm current rushed up his arm into his heart—it was his father's presence, gentle yet profound, as if bridging the boundary between life and death to embrace him. "Father..." he murmured, his eyes slightly reddening. For three years of feigning death, he had never shed a single tear, but now, holding his father's Testament Letter, he finally allowed his emotions to show.

The first jade slip contained the detailed layout of the Tianji Pavilion ruins, including the breaking methods for three layers of formations. Chen Ji scanned through quickly, his eyes gleaming—his father had indeed left a backup plan, the key to breaking the formations being the Chen bloodline rather than brute force. The second jade slip revealed the origin of the spatial rift: in ancient times, the first pavilion master of Tianji tore through space to seal a forbidden artifact, leaving this rift as a "prison." The third jade slip... Chen Ji's breath quickened. Only a few sparse words, yet they exploded in his mind like thunder: "Spiritual perception is trapped within the rift's core, the Heavenly Fate Key's body cannot be forcibly rescued. Remember: only by gathering all fragments of the Tianji Record can the door to save the person be opened."

dialogue.content: Heavenly Fate Key... so that's it. The Holy Sect captured Ling Yuan back then not merely for leverage, but because they coveted her special constitution!

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the jade slip, his knuckles whitening. Now he finally understood the Holy Sect's scheme—the so-called "Heavenly Fate Key" refers to an existence capable of locking or disrupting Heavenly Fate's operations. Chen Nian's bloodline naturally interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight, making this both her curse and her value. The Holy Sect imprisoned her within the spatial rift, clearly intending to harness her abilities for some momentous undertaking. "I will never let you succeed." Chen Ji spoke quietly, his tone terrifyingly composed. He tucked the three jade slips securely against his body and began contemplating how to secretly travel to the Tianji Pavilion ruins—though the location was secluded, his "deceased" identity meant any exposed movements could unravel three years of careful planning.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needed to reach the ruins without revealing his feigned death. He had to choose a covert method of travel.

choices.text: Activating the Demonic Path's mist to conceal his presence.
choices.description: Contacting Ye Qing to borrow her Demonic Path mist ability, which could perfectly mask the Tianji Record's aura.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the Demonic Path mist's enhancement, his movements perfectly hidden.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might seize the opportunity to propose conditions.

text.content: The transmission talisman ignited with pale blue flames as Ye Qing's voice emerged: "Chen Ji? Aren't you dead? What do you want?" Chen Ji briefly explained the situation. After a moment of silence, Ye Qing chuckled: "Demonic Path mist, I can lend you. However... next time there's opportunity at the Tianji Pavilion, I want a share." Chen Ji agreed without hesitation. That night, a dense, ink-like black fog thoroughly enveloped his presence, even perfectly masking the Tianji Record's fluctuations.

choices.memory_label: 与夜清达成交易，获得魔道迷雾加持

choices.text: Disguising as atrashand traveling in disguise.
choices.description: Leveraging thetrashpersona he'd built over three years, dressing up and traveling as an ordinary Servant Disciple.
choices.visible_reward: No need for external assistance, completely independent action.
choices.risk_hint: Risks encountering familiar faces, exposing the deception.

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a set of worn Servant Disciple clothes from his storage bag and changed into them, subtly modifying his features while deliberately adopting a timid, fearful posture. The mirror reflected a frail young man with anxious eyes—a stark contrast to the "deceased" Chen Ji. Pulling his hat low, he slipped out of the cave under cover of night, following secluded paths toward the Tianji Pavilion ruins. Along the way, he encountered several night patrol disciples who didn't even glance his way. Atrashis atrash—who would bother with a walking corpse?

choices.text: Requesting Mo Xiansheng to employ spatial techniques.
choices.description: Employing the remnant power of the guardian soul for short-distance teleportation.
choices.visible_reward: Instant arrival near the ruins, saving considerable time.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng contemplated briefly, then nodded: "My remaining strength, while insufficient for long-distance teleportation, can manage short-distance shifting." Forming seals with both hands, a crack in space opened just wide enough for one person. Chen Ji stepped through, and as the world spun, he found himself in a desolate valley. Mo Xiansheng's form grew increasingly translucent as he sighed: "The ruins' entrance lies half a league ahead... Be careful, something feels off about that place."

choices.memory_label: 墨先生施法传送至遗迹附近，魂力有所消耗

text.content: Night wind howled past, scattering dead leaves everywhere. Chen Ji walked alone through the barren valley, the only sound his own footsteps against the silence. The Tianji Pavilion ruins had stood there for ten thousand years, its former splendor reduced to crumbling walls and broken stones, yet the layered formation lights still flickered in the darkness, as if recounting forgotten history. Chen Ji slowed his pace—according to the jade slip records, three formations separated him from the spatial rift at the core. The first was a maze that trapped intruders forever; the second conjured illusions exploiting the deepest desires and fears; the third tested bloodline, admitting only those of Chen descent. "Thank heavens Father prepared for this." Chen Ji murmured, withdrawing a Jade Pendant etched with the family crest from his chest. His father's final bequest and the key to overcoming the third formation.

But just as Chen Ji stepped toward the first maze formation, he froze. Under the moonlight beside the ruins' entrance, a slender figure stood motionless. Clad in white robes, her long black hair dancing in the night breeze, her face bore a striking resemblance to Chen Ji's own—those eyes, that slight upturn of the lips, exactly as he'd yearned for over five years. "Ling Yuan?" Chen Ji's voice trembled. He rubbed his eyes in disbelief, afraid this might be another illusion or trap. Yet the figure truly existed, even moving toward him with an enigmatic smile. "Brother," she called out, her voice like silver bells yet somehow unfamiliar, "long time no see."

dialogue.content: How are you here? Weren't you trapped in the Temporal Rift?

text.content: Chen Nian smiled faintly at his words, but gave no answer. She walked closer, stopping just three feet from Chen Ji. Her bright eyes flickered with complex emotions. Only then did Chen Ji notice that a faint mist surrounded her—the fluctuation of that mist was identical to Demonic Path Fog! "Brother, I've missed you so much these five years." She spoke softly, her tone carrying no resentment, only a strange calmness. "But this isn't the time for reunion—someone has already set their eyes on this place." Before her words faded, distant rumblings emerged from the darkness, as if large forces were approaching. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart—how could anyone have discovered their location despite his caution?

choice.prompt: Large forces closing in, time running out. Chen Ji must decide instantly—whether to trust the Chen Nian before him or suspect a trap.

choices.text: Grab Chen Nian and immediately enter the ruins
choices.description: Regardless of who approaches, first enter the ruins, use terrain advantages to evade pursuit
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily shake off pursuers, be first to enter the ruins' core
choices.risk_hint: May have fallen into a diverting tactic

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate at all, grabbing Chen Nian's wrist and dashing into the ruins. Her palm was ice-cold, yet an oddly familiar Blood Pulse emanated from it—definitely the real Chen Nian! The pair swiftly navigated through maze formations and illusions, with Chen Nian continuously pointing out weak spots in the barriers, as if she knew the place by heart. "How do you know this place so well?" Chen Ji asked while running. Chen Nian glanced back, a bitter smile forming on her lips: "Because... I've been waiting for brother here for three years."

choices.text: Stand ground and face the enemy, let Chen Nian go first
choices.description: Stay behind to delay pursuers, let Chen Nian enter the ruins' core first

text.content: "Spiritual Nian, you go in first!" Chen Ji halted abruptly, pushing Chen Nian toward the ruins' entrance. His palm had already gathered the power of the Tianji Record, ready to face the incoming enemies. Chen Nian stumbled from his push, panic flashing in her eyes: "Brother, you're insane! Your current cultivation is no match for them!" Chen Ji turned back, revealing a gentle yet resolute smile: "Five years ago, brother failed to protect you. This time, I absolutely will not."

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to peer into the newcomer's identity
choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to examine the pursuers' identity and purpose
choices.visible_reward: Grasp enemy intelligence, know yourself and your enemy
choices.risk_hint: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record

text.content: The Tianji Record flickered frantically at Chen Ji's brow center, the 5 Heavenly Fate points transforming into an esoteric rune that merged into the void. Three breaths later, he "saw" the true appearance of the newcomers—it was Xuanwu Sect's forces, and leading them was Han Lie! That Xuanwu genius Chen Ji had crushed countless times now burned with berserk hatred. "Chen Ji... I finally found you..." Han Lie snarled through gritted teeth in the vision, "This time, I'll make you die without a burial site!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted, a cold smile forming in his heart: what a persistent opponent.

The hoofbeats of pursuers drew ever closer, torchlight illuminating half the night sky. Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. Regardless of whether this "Chen Nian" was real or fake, whether this was another trap, he could not let his sister vanish from his life again. "Spiritual Nian, stay close to me." He grabbed Chen Nian's wrist and sprinted deeper into the ruins. As they passed through the maze formation, surrounding scenery twisted and changed continuously, countless illusions surging like tides—there was Father's face at his final moment, Mother's wails when she disappeared, warm scenes of childhood play with Chen Nian... Yet Chen Ji's will remained as steadfast as bedrock. He firmly held Chen Nian's ice-cold hand, step by step traversing the illusion, racing toward the flickering light of the temporal rift. Behind them, Han Lie's furious roar grew nearer. "Chen Ji! You won't escape!"

The third barrier lay ahead—that was Father's bloodline verification. Chen Ji produced the jade pendant inscribed with their family crest, channeling spiritual energy into it. The pendant glowed with gentle golden light, resonating with the barrier's radiance. The heavy stone door slowly opened, revealing the dark space beyond, shrouded in distorted spacetime. "Brother, this is it." Chen Nian's voice suddenly trembled, "The temporal rift lies just ahead... but I must tell you something." She stopped walking, deep guilt surfacing in those clear eyes, "The reason I was trapped here by the Holy Sect wasn't entirely because they captured me—I chose to come here myself." Chen Ji whirled around, pupils filled with shock and confusion. "What are you saying?"

The temporal rift ahead flickered with eerie light, that distorted space seeming to hide countless secrets and dangers. Chen Ji gazed at the rift, then at his sister—familiar yet strange—countless questions churning in his heart. But he had no time to inquire, for Han Lie's attack came from behind—a fierce flame slicing through the night sky, heading straight for his heart. "Chen Ji, die!" Han Lie's roar thundered like an explosion, the pressure of Xuanwu Sect's top genius overwhelming. Chen Ji sidestepped while shielding Chen Nian behind him. Staring at this nemesis who had pursued him countless times, his lips curved into a cold smile: "Han Lie, you truly are relentless."

Han Lie landed, crimson eyes locked on Chen Ji as if wanting to devour him alive. Three years ago, Chen Ji—despite being called waste—repeatedly crushed him, making him a laughingstock throughout Xuanwu Sect. Now that news of Chen Ji's "death" had spread, he thought he could finally wash away the shame, yet this waste was actually alive! And standing right before him, holding his sister he had searched for years! "Chen Nian was mine to

Just as tensions reached their peak, the spatial rift suddenly erupted with intense fluctuations of brilliant light. A mighty force surged forth from the rift, repelling Chen Ji, Han Lie, and Chen Nian several steps back simultaneously. "This is..." Chen Ji steadied himself, his pupils contracting sharply. He saw a blurred silhouette emerging from the depths of the rift, so massive it nearly blotted out half the sky, with eyes deep as an abyss piercing through time and space, staring directly at him. "Prophets of the ages..." A hoarse yet majestic voice exploded within Chen Ji's mind, "You have finally arrived." In that moment, Chen Ji felt as though something had locked onto his cranial crown, an unprecedented surge of fear and reverence flooding his heart simultaneously. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that legendary existence rumored to control all—had appeared before him in such a manner. And Chen Nian, beneath that terrifying oppressive might, slowly sank to her knees, her face contorted in agonizing struggle. "Brother... save me..." Her voice fragmented and broken, "It is... summoning me..."
